pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which little word goes with the noun "Topf"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

2. What does "hinter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. next to
   C. under
   D. in front of

3. What does "der Freitag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Wednesday
   C. day
   D. Friday

4. What does "November" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. September
   C. March
   D. December

5. What does "die Kerze" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. balloon
   C. candle
   D. cake

6. Which special letter is in "fleißig"? (1 mark)
   A. ü
   B. ö
   C. ß
   D. ä

7. Which German word or phrase means "sugar"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kartoffel
   B. der Saft
   C. der Zucker
   D. der Kohl

8. What is the plural of "das Ohr"? (1 mark)
   A. die Ohrs
   B. die Ohrer
   C. die Ohre
   D. die Ohren

9. What does "trocken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. windy
   B. dry
   C. cloudy
   D. sunny

10. In the word "Schlafzimmer", which part means "sleep"? (1 mark)
   A. zim
   B. Schlaf
   C. mer
   D. Zimmer

11. How is a Rückendiktat done? (1 mark)
   A. You write on the board
   B. You copy from a book
   C. A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word
   D. You read aloud

12. What does "gestern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. tomorrow
   C. always
   D. yesterday

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

14. What is the plural of "das Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschenks
   B. die Geschenker
   C. die Geschenke
   D. die Geschenken

15. Which verb form completes "Vater ___ ein Buch"? (lesen) (1 mark)
   A. lesen
   B. lese
   C. liest
   D. lest

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)

18. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

20. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — der
   It is der Topf, so the little word is der.

2. A — behind
   hinter means behind.

3. D — Friday
   der Freitag means Friday.

4. A — November
   November means November.

5. C — candle
   die Kerze means candle.

6. C — ß
   fleißig has ß.

7. C — der Zucker
   sugar in German is der Zucker.

8. D — die Ohren
   The plural of das Ohr is die Ohren.

9. B — dry
   trocken means dry.

10. B — Schlaf
   Schlaf means sleep and Zimmer means room.

11. C — A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word
   Rücken means back.

12. D — yesterday
   gestern means yesterday.

13. B — das
   It is das Zimmer, so the little word is das.

14. C — die Geschenke
   The plural of das Geschenk is die Geschenke.

15. C — liest
   lesen changes to liest for er.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
